note: EXISTS delegates to the general subquery parser, preserving UNION ALL as a typed QueryStmt::SetOpr instead of flattening the first SELECT.
The EXISTS-only query-subquery helper accepts WITH and top-level UNION/EXCEPT/INTERSECT while scalar and ANY/ALL positions retain their narrower SelectStmt seam.
The exact accepted source row is asserted directly and selected dynamically from the checked Go parser oracle.
EXISTS evaluates both QueryStmt::Select and QueryStmt::SetOpr through the existing query-row path; no catalog mutation is introduced.
